Overnight Country Loaf
Ingredients
PHASE 1 — Levain
28g (1 oz) whole wheat flour
28g (2 tablespoons) water
6g (1 teaspoon) ripe starter
PHASE 2 — Final Dough
450g (1 lb) bread flour
50g (1/3 cup) whole wheat flour
360g (1 1/2 cups) water
10g (2 teaspoons) fine salt
Method
PHASE 1
Mix the levain ingredients and leave at room temperature for 10 hours.
PHASE 2
Mix the flours and water and rest for 40 minutes.
Add the levain and salt, then fold every 30 minutes for 3 hours.
Shape, retard overnight, and bake at 475F in a covered pot for 20 minutes, then 20 uncovered.
Serves 10. Prep 14 hours. Cook 40 mins.
